steps.source_text: Seed the representative RPE1 imaging well and incubate the cells in complete medium.
Prepare and apply the Lipofectamine/plasmid transfection mixture, then culture the transfected cells.
Aspirate the culture medium while retaining adherent cells, add serum-free medium, and serum-starve the cells.
Fix the cells with paraformaldehyde and wash the retained adherent cells three times with PBS.
Permeabilize, quench, and block the fixed cells while retaining the adherent material state.
Incubate with primary antibody and wash the retained cells three times with PBS.
Incubate with Alexa Fluor secondary antibody and wash the retained cells three times with PBS.
Stain nuclei with DAPI, wash, mount the chamber, and acquire a structured confocal image.
